headword: {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}

definitions.explanation: The spread of disease through direct physical contact with an infected person or by touching contaminated surfaces. A key term in public health and hygiene education.

examples.japanese: {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{手|て}を{洗|あら}おう。
examples.english: Let's wash our hands to prevent contact transmission.

examples.japanese: この{病気|びょうき}は{主|おも}に{接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}で{広|ひろ}がる。
examples.english: This disease spreads mainly through contact transmission.

examples.japanese: {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}のリスクを{減|へ}らすために、{公共|こうきょう}の{場所|ばしょ}ではこまめに{消毒|しょうどく}することが{大切|たいせつ}です。
examples.english: To reduce the risk of contact infection, it is important to frequently disinfect in public places.

notes:
A compound of {接触|せっしょく} (contact, touching) and {感染|かんせん} (infection, transmission). Became widely known during the COVID-19 pandemic as one of the main transmission routes discussed in public health messaging.

There are two subtypes: {直接接触感染|ちょくせつせっしょくかんせん} (direct contact infection, through touching an infected person) and {間接接触感染|かんせつせっしょくかんせん} (indirect contact infection, through contaminated surfaces).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent contact transmission
- {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}のリスク: risk of contact infection
- {接触感染|せっしょくかんせん}の{対策|たいさく}: measures against contact transmission

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飛沫感染|ひまつかんせん}: droplet transmission — spread through respiratory droplets
- {空気感染|くうきかんせん}: airborne transmission — spread through airborne particles
- {経口感染|けいこうかんせん}: oral transmission — spread through ingestion
